threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email encrypts the office desktop, the laptops, and the synced Office folder during watermelon harvest
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security awareness training; antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours; no behavior-based detection; the desktop sync client would carry encrypted files into the suite and then into the backup
existing_controls: MFA on the productivity suite for office users; MSP patching and antivirus; firewall
treatment_plan: Annual training in English and Spanish with phishing tips; MSP-managed endpoint detection and response (EDR) with after-hours alerting on the 3 office computers; backup versions extended to 90 days with immutable retention (R-004)

threat_event: Attacker uses the irrigation dealer's always-on remote access to the pump station controller to stop irrigation or change pump and fertigation settings
threat_source: Cybercriminal or opportunistic attacker using a stolen dealer credential
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on cellular gateway; one shared dealer login without MFA; no approval or record of sessions; no security terms in the dealer agreement
existing_controls: Hand-Off-Auto switches at the pump station; pump station panel locked
treatment_plan: Gateway powered on only for approved sessions; named dealer accounts with MFA; each session approved by the Technician and logged; security terms in the dealer agreement

threat_event: Stolen SYS-01 credentials are used to start or stop pivots, change irrigation schedules, or delete field and hours records
threat_source: Cybercriminal using an infostealer or phishing kit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Technician administrator account without MFA; passwords saved in browsers on the office computers; irrigation change alerts switched off; no audit review
existing_controls: MFA on the Owner and General Manager account; vendor audit trail
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for every SYS-01 user; turn on irrigation start, stop, and schedule change alerts to two phones; monthly audit trail review

threat_event: Backups are deleted or encrypted along with production, or cannot be restored, so payroll, H-2A, and program files and the pump station program are lost
threat_source: Ransomware group targeting backups; MSP error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-08 not immutable; one password-only MSP administrator account; never restore-tested; SYS-01 never exported; pump station program only on the dealer laptop
existing_controls: Nightly SYS-08 copy with 30 days of versions; FMIS vendor backups
treatment_plan: 90-day immutable versions; MFA on the backup console; first restore test by 2026-09-30, then quarterly; monthly SYS-01 export to an offline drive; farm-held copy of the controller program

threat_event: Payroll and H-2A files (Social Security, passport, and visa numbers) are stolen during a ransomware attack and published or used for identity fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office folder shared with four users and synced to an unencrypted desktop; no inventory of where personal data lives; no alert on mass download
existing_controls: MFA on the productivity suite
treatment_plan: Restrict the Office folder to the Office Manager and the Owner and General Manager; stop syncing it to the desktop; encrypt the desktop; data inventory; suite alerts for mass download and new forwarding rules

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a packer-shipper, buying point, or gin payment, or a supplier payment, to an attacker's account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment instructions arrive by email; the Field Supervisor mailbox has no MFA; no staff training
existing_controls: The bank calls the Owner and General Manager back before adding a new payee; MFA on 3 of 4 mailboxes
treatment_plan: MFA on every mailbox; written rule to confirm any change in payment instructions by phone to a known number; covered in training

threat_event: Irrigation automation fails during a hot, dry spell at watermelon fruit set and only one person can run the pump station and pivots by hand
threat_source: Equipment failure, power surge, or vendor outage; absence of the Irrigation and Equipment Technician
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hand-operation procedure not written down; nobody else trained; River Tract 9 miles away
existing_controls: Hand-Off-Auto switches on every pump and pivot; the Technician knows the procedure
treatment_plan: Written hand-operation procedure in English and Spanish posted at the pump station and in each pivot panel; the Field Supervisor trained and drilled before the 2027 season

threat_event: Fertigation injection rate or run time is changed, by an attacker or by mistake, burning watermelons or exposing workers to fertilizer or chemicals
threat_source: Attacker through the dealer gateway or the shop network; operator error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default touchscreen PIN; no hard limits recorded in the controller program; no change log
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 ID.RA-07 (benchmark); SP 800-82r3; N11-R01 (food defense approach used as a voluntary checklist)
existing_controls: Injector valves closed outside fertigation runs; the Technician checks each run
treatment_plan: Dealer sets hard maximum injection rate and run time in the program; change PIN; change log approved by the Technician

threat_event: Daily hours and Produce Safety records entered under the shared field crew login are wrong or disputed and cannot be tied to the person who did the work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared SYS-01 login on the field tablet; no screen lock; no review of edits
existing_controls: Field Supervisor reviews hours weekly before payroll
treatment_plan: Named SYS-01 crew accounts with a tablet PIN; screen lock on the tablet; weekly review of record edits

threat_event: A departed staff member's account is used to read or forward farm email and files
threat_source: Former insider or attacker using a stale account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No departure checklist; no account review; former bookkeeper mailbox active with a forwarding rule from January to 2026-07-21
existing_controls: None before 2026-07-21; account disabled that day
treatment_plan: Last-day checklist; monthly account reconciliation; block automatic forwarding outside the farm

threat_event: SYS-01 vendor outage during watermelon harvest lasts longer than the 8-hour RTO for harvest and irrigation
threat_source: FMIS vendor or its connectivity subservice failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS system of record; vendor RTO (8 h) equals the BIA RTO; no farm-held export
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 report; hand operation; paper forms
treatment_plan: Paper harvest log and hours forms in the field kit; monthly export (R-004); recovery commitment requested at contract renewal

threat_event: The single internet line at the shop fails in season
threat_source: Internet provider failure or storm damage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One fixed-wireless line with no failover
existing_controls: Pivots and probes use their own cellular modems; SYS-01 works from phones; phone hotspot for the office
treatment_plan: Accepted: irrigation control and harvest records do not depend on the shop line; office work can move to a phone hotspot for a day or two

threat_event: A hurricane or lightning strike damages the pump station controller, the VFD, or the shop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No surge protection on the pump station; no spare controller; program held only by the dealer; no hurricane checklist
existing_controls: Crop insurance; hand operation of the pivot wells
treatment_plan: Surge protection on the pump station panel; farm-held program copy (R-004); hurricane checklist in the contingency plan

threat_event: Dealer technicians or an attacker using a dealer account view or export operator location history and machine data
threat_source: Dealer insider or attacker using a dealer account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing dealer access to the telematics account; no access terms; nobody reviews the portal user list
existing_controls: Portal requires a password for each user
treatment_plan: Remove standing dealer access; grant it per service visit; access and retention terms with the dealer

threat_event: A stolen or lost office desktop, phone, or field tablet exposes H-2A and payroll files or gives access to SYS-01
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Desktop unencrypted with the synced Office folder; field tablet without a screen lock; phones unmanaged
existing_controls: Laptops encrypted; office locked when unattended
treatment_plan: Encrypt the desktop; screen lock and remote wipe on tablets and phones through the suite's basic mobile management

threat_event: Staff do not recognize a phishing email or report an incident quickly, so an attack spreads before anyone acts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security awareness training; no reporting rule; no Spanish-language guidance; the 2025 phishing event was never recorded
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Annual training in English and Spanish; reporting card at the shop and in the field kit; monthly tip at the crew meeting

threat_event: Security work lapses because nobody is responsible, there are no written policies, and risks are not tracked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No designated owner before 2026-08-31; no policies; no risk register
existing_controls: None before 2026
treatment_plan: Security Coordinator designated in writing (done 2026-08-31); POL-02, POL-03, POL-04 approved (done 2026-08-31); monthly 30-minute POA&M review with the Owner and General Manager

threat_event: The AI vendor uses farm imagery and yield data to train or benchmark models for other customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Click-through terms allow secondary use; no approved-tools list; no contract review
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Negotiated data terms (no secondary use without opt-in; deletion on exit) or end the pilot (P10)

threat_event: The yield model over-estimates watermelon loads, so the farm over-commits loads to the packer-shipper and then cuts crew hours at short notice
threat_source: Model error (canopy hides fruit; new variety)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot model not validated on the farm's varieties; estimates used directly for load commitments
existing_controls: Owner and General Manager reviews estimates against field walks
treatment_plan: Hand-count check before any commitment; commitments capped at 85% of the estimate; no H-2A hours cut on an estimate alone (P10)

threat_event: Someone on the shop Wi-Fi reaches the pump station controller over the flat network and changes settings
threat_source: Contractor, visitor, or attacker on the shop Wi-Fi
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat network; Wi-Fi password shared with dealer technicians and contractors and unchanged since 2022; default touchscreen PIN
existing_controls: Firewall blocks inbound internet traffic
treatment_plan: Separate network segment for the pump station with firewall rules; separate guest Wi-Fi; change the staff Wi-Fi password and the touchscreen PIN

threat_event: The MSP's remote management tool or administrator account is compromised and used to push ransomware to every office computer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The MSP tool can run commands on every office computer; no evidence of how the MSP protects it; no incident notice term in the contract
existing_controls: MSP states its technicians use MFA
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review with a short questionnaire and evidence; contract amendment for 24-hour incident notice, a technician list, and a recovery time commitment

threat_event: A breach at the FMIS vendor exposes or alters the farm's field, hours, and Produce Safety records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS system of record
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report (unmodified opinion); monthly export once R-004 is done
treatment_plan: Accepted: vendor controls are evidenced by its SOC 2 report; the vendor must notify the farm under Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) as a third-party agent; residual risk Low

threat_event: An internet attacker finds the pump station cellular gateway's administration page and signs in with the manufacturer's default password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway admin page reachable from the internet with the default password (found by P07 testing on 2026-08-12); gateway firmware never updated
existing_controls: None before 2026-08-14
treatment_plan: Default password changed and internet-facing administration turned off by the dealer on 2026-08-14; firmware update and retest by 2026-09-30
